candidates.logistic_regression: LogisticRegression(C=1, max_iter=3000, lbfgs) on raw 960 pixels, no normalization; baseline identical to the historical model

cnn_recipe.architecture: conv3x3(1->w)-relu-maxpool2 / conv3x3(w->2w)-relu-maxpool2 / conv3x3(2w->4w)-relu / global_avg_pool / dropout(0.2, training only) / dense(4w->4) / softmax; padding 1, stride 1, no batch normalization
cnn_recipe.augmentation: independent random horizontal and vertical flips, p=0.5 each

protocol.summary_statistics: mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) over seeds
protocol.tie_rule: if cnn_w8 mean validation F1 macro is within 0.01 of cnn_w16, select cnn_w8 (cheaper inference)
protocol.deployed_model: seed-42 run of the selected architecture (fixed in advance, not the best seed)
protocol.test_policy: fresh test evaluated exactly once, only for the selected model and the logistic regression baseline (reference)
protocol.test_statistics: percentile bootstrap 95% CI, 1000 resamples, numpy default_rng(42)
protocol.binary_derivation: anomaly = any predicted class other than No-Anomaly

selected_model.name: cnn_w16
selected_model.selection_reason: highest mean validation F1 macro; if cnn_w8 mean validation F1 macro is within 0.01 of cnn_w16, select cnn_w8 (cheaper inference)

backend_convclassifier_parity.source: backend/src/infra/cnn.py ConvClassifier vs solar_ml.export.forward, checked after training
